name: GDGROUP
recent: Golden Destinations 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日召开特别股东大会，股东全数通过两项拟议收购（包括以 RM45 million 收购总部及收购香港旅行社）。公司于 11 月 19 日公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，并获董事经理 Lim Swee Kok 于 11 月 20 日及 23 日在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 股东在 2026 年 9 月 17 日的特别股东大会上通过两项拟议收购。
公司拟以 RM45 million 收购总部物业。
公司拟收购一家香港旅行社。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM113.165 million，净利为 RM0.294 million，净利率 0.3%。

recent_en: Golden Destinations held an EGM on 17 September 2026 where shareholders approved two proposed acquisitions, including the RM45 million headquarters acquisition and the acquisition of a Hong Kong travel agency. The company announced its 3Q2026 results on 19 November, and Managing Director Lim Swee Kok acquired shares in the open market on 20 and 23 November.
notable_en: Shareholders approved two proposed acquisitions at the EGM held on 17 September 2026.
The company proposed to acquire its headquarters property for RM45 million.
The company proposed to acquire a Hong Kong travel agency.
earnings_en: For 3Q2026 (period ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM113.165 million, net profit was RM0.294 million, with a net margin of 0.3%.
